title: Akta Pure General Protocol
author: Annie Kwon
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.4ipgudn
materials: Perform a pump wash (and/or system wash) with buffers in reverse order of how they will be used. For example, if you intend to run a sequence of 1) A1-buffer1, 2) B1-buffer2, you will want to run a pump wash (and/or system wash) for B1, then A1.

steps.title: Connect and filter buffer bottles
steps.instruction: Connect up to four buffer bottles to lines A1, A2, B1, and B2; fully submerge the line ends in the buffer and filter each buffer through a 0.22 µm filter before connection.

steps.title: Prime pumps and purge air
steps.instruction: In Unicorn select each buffer inlet line (e.g., A1) and start a pump flow of 5–10 mL/min; attach a purge syringe to the pump purge valve, open the valve at least half a turn, gently draw back until no air bubbles remain, close the valve, remove the syringe, and repeat for the other purge valve.

steps.title: Load water into injection loop
steps.instruction: Fill a syringe with at least twice the sample‑loop volume of water; set the injection valve to “inject” and connect the syringe to the syringe port; set the valve to “manual load”, start a buffer pump flow, then plunge the water syringe into the port so water exits the waste line.

steps.title: Load sample into injection loop
steps.instruction: Set the injection valve to “inject”, remove the water syringe and attach a syringe containing the sample; set the valve to “manual load” and plunge the sample into the port; perform a partial loop fill (< ½ loop volume) to conserve sample or a total loop fill (sample volume = 2 × loop volume) to avoid dilution.

steps.title: Set low flow rate and column mode
steps.instruction: Set the flow rate to a low value (e.g., 0.5 mL/min) and change the column setting from “bypass” to “column down flow”.

steps.title: Install column and connect outlet
steps.instruction: Remove the stop plugs from both ends of the column and connect the column outlet tubing (from port 1B of column valve V9‑Cs) to the bottom of the column.

steps.title: Configure pre‑column pressure alarm
steps.instruction: In Unicorn go to Manual Instructions → Alarms → Alarm pre column pressure and set the high‑pressure alarm limit appropriate for the column.

steps.title: Remove storage buffer and equilibrate column
steps.instruction: Run at least one column volume of water to remove storage buffer, then run ≥ 1.5 column volumes of starting buffer until pressure, UV, and conductivity readings are stable (refer to the column manual for specifics).

steps.title: Load sample onto equilibrated column
steps.instruction: With the column equilibrated, set the injection valve to “inject” to load the sample onto the column; set the desired flow rate with the starting buffer and verify that pressure, UV, and conductivity are stable.

steps.title: Set up fraction collector
steps.instruction: Fill the fraction collector with tubes, place the tube sensor against Tube 1, and configure the collector to collect fractions by volume or UV; note that slower flow rates increase resolution.

steps.title: Run chromatography as desired
steps.instruction: Manipulate flow rate and buffer %B to run the column according to the experimental method, collecting fractions as configured.

steps.title: Elute and collect fractions
steps.instruction: Elute samples by adjusting flow rate and %B; collecting smaller fractions can improve resolution.

steps.title: Clean column with solutions
steps.instruction: Attach up to two cleaning solutions (e.g., 0.1–1 M NaOH), water, and 20 % ethanol to the buffer lines and purge pumps; perform a system wash for the inlet line of the solution you intend to use first.

steps.title: Run first cleaning solution then NaOH
steps.instruction: Run the first cleaning solution through the column until UV stabilizes at 0; then run NaOH, setting the injection valve to “inject” and directing column outflow to the fraction collector then waste, continuing NaOH until UV again stabilizes at 0.

steps.title: Flush column and system with water
steps.instruction: Set the injection valve to “inject” and send column outflow to the fraction collector then waste while running water to flush all flowpaths.

steps.title: Run 20 % ethanol through system
steps.instruction: With the injection valve set to “inject”, run 20 % ethanol, directing outflow to the fraction collector then waste to fill the entire flowpath with ethanol.

steps.title: Re‑equilibrate with starting buffer
steps.instruction: Repeat the equilibration step with the starting buffer as described in step 8.

steps.title: Perform pump wash with water
steps.instruction: Place all buffer lines to be used (e.g., A1, B1) into filtered water; in Unicorn select each buffer inlet line and click “Start pump wash” to wash pumps A and B with water.

steps.title: Connect column inlet tubing drop‑to‑drop
steps.instruction: With flow running, let buffer drip from the column inlet tubing (port 1A of column valve V9‑Cs) into the column connection port until the port is filled; then connect the tubing to the column to avoid bubble formation.

steps.title: System wash if ethanol present
steps.instruction: If the system contains ethanol, perform a water wash of the entire system before running any buffer, especially high‑salt buffers.
